subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summary After the death of father, Muhammad-Bin-Tughlaq ascended the throne in 1325. The most learned king of Delhi Muhammad removed his capital from Delhi to Deogiri in 1327. Issuing a token currency of copper instead of silver, raising land tax, invading Khurasan, defeating Nagarkot were some important things he made during his dominion. His second attack to capture Karajal was a failure.
